Vintage Tobacciana Pipe Lot
Wood Pipe Rack with Humidor Jar, 6 Estate Pipes
7 Items, Mid-20th Century
This vintage tobacciana lot includes a wooden pipe rack with an integrated glazed ceramic humidor jar and six estate briar smoking pipes. The hardwood stand features eight pipe rests across two wings with turned spindles and brass nuts. Accompanied by six briar pipes in varied classic straight and bent shapes with rusticated and smooth finishes.
